speaker: (the vicar)
text: Twice in fourteen months the Lord has laid His hand on this town.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: And you will ask why.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: For a people that turn God's barley into drink.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: You steep it on the Sabbath.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: You dry it on the Sabbath.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: And you call that your living.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: Every malt-kiln in this parish knows the day it does its work.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: A town that will not keep the Sabbath will not keep the corn.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: Look upon your kilns.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: The smoke goes up before the bells are done.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: Twice in fourteen months. Count them.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: The hand was not light, and the hand was not mistaken.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: Strong drink is not the trade this pulpit will bless.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: The steep on the Lord's day is the steep against the Lord's day.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: I have said it since July. I say it again, because the ash is still in the north end.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: Malt was made to be bread. You have made it a kiln.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: He said fourteen. He said it as a count.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Sit. We are not here to keep his arithmetic.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let it come whole. I will not mend it in the pew.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: The barley is still the town's work, whatever he makes of the day it is done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then he has his reason by the amen. So has everybody, by Sunday.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Judith has his voice already. She is storing it for the table.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Twice was the first head. Strong drink was the second. The Sabbath was the third.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the heads till we are out of the lane.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The meat is at home. The sermon can walk there by itself.

speaker: (the vicar)
text: Amen is not a pardon. Amen is the end of the reason.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: He counted fourteen on his fingers. I saw the fingers.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Then you have seen the sermon. Sit still until the lane.
